sections.title: One more adjective
sections.content: *közeli* means "close" in the relationship sense (a close family, a close friend) — not to be confused with *közel* ("near", the plain place-adverb). Use *közeli* right before the noun it describes, exactly like any other adjective you already know.
*minden vasárnap* reuses *minden* ("every") from A1, as in *minden nap*. This screen is new vocabulary plugged into structures you already own.
